veranderings.rede: The plural of 'nes' is 'neste', so the compound is 'perdebyneste'; this is a block heading, so the reviewer should send it to the writer if the script cannot apply it there.
'Doringtakke' is the natural Afrikaans compound for thorny branches.

veranderings.voor: Perde en beeste staan binne in hul eie hokkies.
veranderings.na: Daarbinne staan perde en beeste in hul eie hokkies.
veranderings.rede: 'binne in' reads as 'inside their stalls'; 'daarbinne' makes clear the animals stand inside the stable, each in its own stall.
'Aanmekaar' (joined together) is written as one word, as the lesson itself does in 'aanmekaar sit'.

veranderings.voor: 'n Dun buitekant om die ruimte binne wat sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou.
veranderings.na: 'n Dun buitekant wat om 'n ruimte sit en sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou.
veranderings.rede: In the original, 'wat sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou' seems to belong to 'die ruimte binne' rather than the outside, and 'die ruimte binne' sounds stiff.

vlae.blok: Nie elke skuiling pas in een groep nie
vlae.teks: 'n Kraal van klip is nie 'n raam of 'n dop nie, maar 'n dik muur.
vlae.rede: Read literally, this says the kraal itself is a thick wall, though a kraal is an open enclosure with a wall around it (as the lesson says elsewhere). Saying it has or is made of a thick wall would change the claim slightly, so I flag it rather than change it.
